titulo_es: Follow references and connectors in long texts

하지만 도로는 여전히 막혀요.en: But the roads are still congested

그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요.es: Por eso surgió la propuesta de reducir el aparcamiento
그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요.en: That's why the proposal to reduce the parking lot came up.

texto: The connectors mark cause, contrast and conclusion; follow their relationships so as not to attribute a reason to the wrong phrase.
The buses were increased. But the roads are still congested. That's why the proposal to reduce the parking lot came up.
